# PartRevive

> Made-to-order 3D-printed replacement parts for appliances, RVs, tools and cars. New shop (launched October 2026). Nothing is stocked: send a photo, get a quote within 24 hours on business days, lead time 5 to 10 business days after approval. Not affiliated with any brand named; names identify fit only.

## Main
- [PartRevive: Made-to-order 3D-printed replacement parts](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/): PartRevive makes replacement plastic parts to order by 3D printing. Send a photo of the broken part and get a quote within 24 hours on business days.

## Guides
- [Can a Broken Plastic Part Be 3D Printed? Checklist](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/can-this-plastic-part-be-3d-printed/): Most broken plastic parts under 250 mm can be 3D printed if they are not food-contact, not safety-critical and not exposed to high heat. If the part sits in the sun or heat we use ASA, and for high load we use carbon-fibre nylon (PA-CF).
- [Broken Center Console Latch: Options and Prices](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/center-console-latch-broken-options/): A center console latch usually breaks because its small plastic hook is thin, loaded every time the lid closes, and baked by cabin heat. You can buy an aftermarket latch, ask a dealer, or have a made-to-fit latch printed in PETG or ASA, which we quote within 24 hours on business days.
- [Cooler Latch and Hinge Repair: Options and Prices](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/cooler-latch-hinge-repair-yeti-rtic-igloo-coleman/): A cooler latch or hinge usually fails at the pin hole, where a rubber latch stretches or a plastic hinge splits. Official sets cost about $10 to $17 when they fit, and a printed TPU latch or PETG hinge makes sense when you only need one piece or the set does not match.
- [DeWalt TSTAK Latch Keeps Breaking? Causes and Fixes](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/dewalt-tstak-latch-keeps-breaking/): A DeWalt TSTAK latch usually breaks from side loads, cold plastic and lifting a stack by the handle. A replacement printed in carbon-fibre nylon (PA-CF), with layers aligned to the load, resists repeat breaks, and we quote a pair from $12 within 24 hours.
- [Fridge Door Bin Broken? Replace, Repair or Print](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/fridge-door-bin-broken-options/): A broken fridge door bin can be replaced with an original part, a used part, or a part printed to order. Originals are the surest fit but often cost $115 to $200 or more and are sometimes out of stock, while a printed bin typically costs less and is made to your model.
- [How to Photograph a Broken Part for a Quote](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/how-to-photograph-a-broken-part-for-a-quote/): Photograph the broken part from the top, side and mounting end with a coin or ruler beside it, and add the model number. That is usually enough for us to quote within 24 hours on business days.
- [RV Screen Door Latch Replacement: Fit and Options](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/rv-screen-door-latch-replacement-guide/): To replace a broken RV screen door latch, first work out whether it is a left-hand or right-hand door, then measure the distance between the mounting holes. If a stock kit does not match, we print an exact-fit paddle or handle in ASA from a photo, quoted within 24 hours on business days.
- [RV Window Latch Replacement Guide: Options and Cost](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/rv-window-latch-replacement-guide/): To replace a broken RV window latch, identify the window style, then choose an original assembly, a used part, or a printed latch. Printed latches in UV-resistant ASA typically cost $7 to $24 elsewhere, and we quote from $18 per latch within 24 hours.
- [Guides to fixing broken plastic parts | PartRevive](https://jdinneen.github.io/partrevive/guides/): Plain-English guides on repairing or replacing broken plastic parts, and when a made-to-order 3D-printed part is the answer.
